newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: CRH spent 48 mln punts on investments in H1.
newsitem.headline: CRH spent 48 mln punts on investments in H1.

text.p: CRH Plc said on Thursday that it had undertaken acquisitions and investments of 48 million Irish pounds in the first six months of 1997 and divestments amounting to 39 million punts.
The building materials group said its unit Irish Cement had started work on a 13 million punt kiln upgrade project in Ireland while it spent 13 million on acquisitions in the Netherlands and Belgium.
In North America, the group spent 22 million acquiring businesses in northern New Mexico and southern Colorado, New York, Pennsylvania and Massachusetts.

CRH said its material group in the U.S. continues its programme of disposing of the surplus assets of Tilcon, acquired from BTR for $329 million last year, while T.B.F. Thompson Group sold its asphalt and road surfacing operations in southeast England.
The company said that it also sold its 50 percent investment in a Dutch concrete additives companies and its 50 percent stake in a German concrete paving company.
